# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report security vulnerabilities via GitHub Security Advisories:

1. Go to https://github.com/ncsound919/Mutly/security/advisories/new
2. Describe the vulnerability in detail
3. We will respond within 48 hours

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
|---------|-----------|
| 0.1.x   | ✅ Yes |

## Security Scan Results

Security scans run on every push and PR:
- CodeQL (SAST)
- Secretlint (secret detection)
- npm/pnpm audit (dependency vulnerabilities)
- Trivy (container scanning)

Results are available in the GitHub Security tab.
